canonical_title: Hull and main float takeoff conditions.

versions.title_at_revision: Hull and main float takeoff condition.
versions.text:
For the wing and its attachment to the hull or main float--
(a) The aerodynamic wing lift is assumed to be zero; and
(b) A downward inertia load, corresponding to a load factor computed from the following formula, must be applied: where-- n = inertia load factor; = empirical seaplane operations factor equal to 0.004; = seaplane stalling speed at the design takeoff weight within the flaps extended in the appropriate takeoff position; = angle of dead rise at the main step (degrees); and W = seaplane design takeoff weight in pounds.

versions.text:
For the wing and its attachment to the hull or main float--
(a) The aerodynamic wing lift is assumed to be zero; and
(b) A downward inertia load, corresponding to a load factor computed from the following formula, must be applied: where-- n = inertia load factor; = empirical seaplane operations factor equal to 0.004; = seaplane stalling speed [(knots)] at the design takeoff weight within the flaps extended in the appropriate takeoff position; = angle of dead rise at the main step (degrees); and W = [design water takeoff weight in pounds.]
